title: Zid-An Sek-Eel
summary: Zid-An Sek-Eel is an Arcane Enhancement for Tektolyst Artifacts that grants Invisibility for 30s on Tauron Strike and increases Tauron Strike Charge Rate.
extract:
Zid-An Sek-Eel is an Arcane Enhancement for Tektolyst Artifacts that grants Invisibility for 30s on Tauron Strike and increases Tauron Strike Charge Rate.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Marie for a randomly determined amount of Perita resources in her rotating shop.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Invisibility duration starts as soon as the player casts their Tauron Strike, not after it finishes, resulting in less actionable time while invisible.
